name: footzi-monorepo
description: Footzi — Premium Footwear Ecommerce Platform inspired by modern minimalism and Agra architectural heritage

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' SIGINT SIGTERM; npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.render:build: npm ci --prefix server --include=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build

author: Footzi Team
